name: Цифровой дневник
essence: A lyric-video collage that speaks a love song through the interface grammar of phone and OS: tracker screens, chat bubbles, camera UI and glitching captions, each line set as a different system moment. Hard cuts on the lyric beat swing between paper-white UI calm and near-black voids before closing on a glowing brand mark.
material_and_look: Flat off-white UI canvases with tiny monospace subtitles, interrupted by one saturated green tracker field and dark dimmed overlays. Everything reads as screen chrome: rounded bubbles, thin-line icons, small corner handle watermark.
colour_logic: Neutral light grey (#e8e8e8) and near-black alternate as the main inversion. A single deep green scene and a system-blue chat bubble act as rare accents, with the final logo carrying the only gradient.
type_and_layout: Big tight grotesk lyric lines centred or left-aligned, sometimes with an inline emoji or arrow glyph spliced into the word. Tiny caption text sits bottom-centre, and a persistent small logo plus handle sits upper-right.
motion_quality: Mostly still holds with small UI micro-motions such as ring draws, bubble pops, counters ticking and a glow pulse. Datamosh-style glitch scatter breaks up one transition for energy.
camera_and_transitions: Hard cuts at roughly 0.8 per second, locked to the lyric phrasing, with occasional light-to-dark inversion and one glitch-smear wipe. The camera stays static apart from a slight punch-in on key words.
sound: A soft melancholic pop vocal track drives the edit, with lyric lines landing on downbeats. Light UI clicks, message pops and a soft whoosh into the final logo reveal punctuate it.
cannot_render: photographic iPad screenshots and dimmed photo collages
